lines.text: Until 1822, Europeans had no idea where birds went in the winter.
Famous scientists genuinely believed birds buried themselves in mud or turned into mice.
Then, one spring day in Germany...
a white stork landed with a thirty-inch wooden spear pierced straight through its neck.
The bird was completely fine, strutting around like nothing happened.
When scientists inspected the weapon, they discovered it was carved from African wood
and used exclusively by hunters in Central Africa.
That meant this single stubborn bird had flown over three thousand miles
across the Sahara Desert and Mediterranean Sea...
with a giant spear stuck all the way through its body!
It single-handedly solved the mystery of seasonal bird migration,
and today, the famous Pfeilstorch is still preserved in a German museum!
